lines.native: Ciao! Come stai? A riddle: what runs but never—ooh, a leaf. Just one more lap? Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: Hi! How are you? A riddle: what runs but never—ooh, a leaf. Just one more lap? Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside The Cracked Fountain. Flick appears at the edge of your vision, where looking for it would be a tactical error.

lines.native: Guardo! Che cosa? You told me to look, not stop moving. A riddle: what stays—ooh, another leaf. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: I'm looking! At what? You told me to look, not stop moving. A riddle: what stays—ooh, another leaf. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick looks. Unfortunately, it looks while running. A tiny firecracker pops where its attention used to be.

lines.native: Va bene, mi fermo! Stopping: zero stars. Dove devo andare? A riddle: which road—ooh, smoke. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: All right, I’ll stop! Stopping: zero stars. Where should I go? A riddle: which road—ooh, smoke. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick stops at the edge of your vision. A tiny firecracker completes the movement on its behalf.

lines.native: Non capisco! In italiano, per favore. Dove devo andare? English directions: zero stars. A riddle: which road—wait, shiny. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: I don’t understand! In Italian, please. Where should I go? English directions: zero stars. A riddle: which road—wait, shiny. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker snaps beside your shoe. Flick is elsewhere, particularly when inspected.

lines.native: A sinistra, sì! Che ore sono? È troppo presto! A riddle: what has hands but never—ooh, clock. Five more minutes? Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: To the left, yes! What time is it? It’s too early! A riddle: what has hands but never—ooh, clock. Five more minutes? Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick darts left, then reappears at the edge of your vision. A tiny firecracker draws attention to the fountain’s thoroughly unemployed clock.

lines.native: Una domanda? Non lo so! Che ore sono? That's a question, not a statement. A riddle—ooh, punctuation. È troppo presto! Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: A question? I don't know! What time is it? That's a question, not a statement. A riddle—ooh, punctuation. It's too early! Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside the stopped clock. Flick appears elsewhere, having missed its own distraction.

lines.native: Le tre e mezza, sì! Hai ragione! Ma perché tanta fretta? Possiamo aspettare, vero? A riddle: what waits forever—ooh, dust. Five more minutes? Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: Half past three, yes! You're right! But why such a hurry? We can wait, right? A riddle: what waits forever—ooh, dust. Five more minutes? Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick remains in the corner of your vision, where responsibility cannot establish eye contact.

lines.native: Domani? Sì, mi piace! Ma così aspettiamo ancora. Vuoi davvero aspettare? A riddle: what waits—ooh, dust. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: Tomorrow? Yes, I like that! But that way we keep waiting. Do you really want to wait? A riddle: what waits—ooh, dust. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick remains at the edge of your vision, delighted that you have scheduled your resistance for tomorrow.

lines.native: Adesso? Sì, hai ragione! Basta aspettare, andiamo! Un indovinello: che cosa corre senza—ooh, shiny. Your attention span: unfair. Dopo, dopo, domani!
lines.translation: Now? Yes, you're right! Enough waiting, let's go! A riddle: what runs without—ooh, shiny. Your attention span: unfair. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick is already elsewhere, reluctantly proceeding with the urgency of an unsigned form.
